text: {"lessons":["I will judge each holding by its future prospects and its role in my portfolio, not by my average cost or whether it shows a gain or loss.","Selling Stock A at a gain felt rewarding, but I will not sell simply to lock in a profit or cling to a losing position to avoid regret.","With random price movements and only modest changes so far, I will avoid frequent or short-term reactions and trade only for a clear portfolio or investment reason."]}
